notes.title: Micro content update
notes.notes:
Added some new vehicles
Added ability to restart Challenge runs from in game pause menu.
Some UI tweaks.

notes.title: Quality of life patch
notes.notes:
Added an option to change the standard in-game camera's Field of View.
Added a framerate limiter in the options to allow for higher framerates.
Fixed an issue where the reticule was always showing even when set to off.
Fixed missing collision on cliffs in "Cool BBQ Nights."

notes.title: Small patch: Settings save changes
notes.notes:
Settings are now saved outside the progress save slots.
 Previous settings will have been reset to their defaults.
 Fixed bug letting players change levels inside challenge runs.
 Various small level tweaks.

notes.title: Patch Notes 20/06/2024
notes.notes: - Fixed collision issues on various small foliage

notes.title: Patch Notes 19/06/2024
notes.notes:
- Fixed some minor unexpected collision issues
- Fixed misalignment on HUD UI ability icons
- Expanded translations
